نعتور (form VIII)
# نَعْتَوِرُ (naʕtawiru) /naʕ.ta.wi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# نُعْتَوَرُ (nuʕtawaru) /nuʕ.ta.wa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# نَعْتَوِرَ (naʕtawira) /naʕ.ta.wi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# نُعْتَوَرَ (nuʕtawara) /nuʕ.ta.wa.ra/:
